235b.prompt: These are two crops from the same NBHL ball-hockey recording. Compare the central player in image A with the central player in image B. Decide whether visible evidence establishes the same individual, establishes different individuals, or is insufficient. Team uniform or similar appearance alone does not establish the same individual.
